title: The Weighing Hour
logline: On a gem-trading street, a dealer's flat, expert glance under a loupe meets a miner's family who has carried one stone a long way, hoping.
human_question: Why does the calm, unexcited offer sometimes carry more weight than the hopeful one?

premise.story: A working day on a gem-trading street: practised dealers examining stones with professional detachment, a family bringing a single stone with real hope riding on it, the bargaining talk, and whatever price is finally reached or refused.
premise.place: A gem-trading street in a gem-mining town.
premise.experience: Loupes, scales and quiet, expert hands; the tension between a dealer's flat calm and a seller's open hope; the long wait for a number.

concept_links.why: The dealer's unexcited, businesslike wanting and the family's joyful hope are the concept's own contrast between neutral and joyful greed-rooted minds, and between reasons offered and reasons withheld [C006-M:L19] [C006-P:L74].
The dealer's steady, practised effort and settled decision under the loupe echo the concept's picture of effort and decision (adhimokkha) at work in a trained craft [C021-P:L45] [C021-M:L19].

what_camera_could_observe: A loupe raised to an eye, a stone turned in light
A family waiting, hopeful, off to one side
The bargaining talk and its pauses
A price accepted, or the family walking on to try another dealer
what_must_be_real: A real stone, a real family's stake and a real dealer's trade. No price or negotiation staged for the camera.

possible_arc.opening: Morning light on a street of small shopfronts and loupes.
possible_arc.turn: A stone is examined, and the room goes quiet.
possible_arc.ending_open: A deal is struck, refused, or taken elsewhere. Reality decides.

requirements: A gem-trading street with dealers willing to be filmed appraising
A seller or family willing to have their sale filmed
Trust built with dealers over more than one visit, given the sensitivity of prices

suggestions.name: The gem-trading street in Ratnapura town
suggestions.why: Sri Lanka's best-known gem-trading centre, with a long-established street of dealers.
suggestions.access_notes: Trading and prices are sensitive; access depends on dealers' trust.
suggestions.verify: No dealer or seller has been contacted; willingness to film real transactions is unconfirmed.

risks: Portraying dealers as predatory, which would be defamatory in effect
Exposing a family's financial hardship without full consent
Filming real prices could carry commercial sensitivity
drop_if: No dealer will allow real appraisals and prices to be filmed
A seller's hardship cannot be shown with dignity and consent

connections.note: The same stone traded here is cut and set there: one craft in dealing, another in shaping.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
